transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—thanks for coming today. To start, can you tell me what's been bothering you or what brings you in today?
I’ve been feeling worn out almost every day. Even if I get a full night’s sleep, I wake up still dragging, mentally and physically, and it makes getting through my cashier shift harder.
How long have you been feeling this constant tiredness—days, weeks, or months?
About a year and three months now—since our older relative moved in with us.
Over the past couple of weeks, have you noticed a persistent low mood or a loss of interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy?
No, I wouldn’t say I’ve felt persistently down, and I’m still interested in the things I usually enjoy.
Has anyone told you that you snore loudly or stop breathing/gasp during sleep?
I’m not really sure. No one’s mentioned anything like that to me.
Over the past several months, have you found yourself worrying excessively about different things—more than you feel you can control—along with feeling tense or on edge?
Yeah, I do. My mind keeps jumping from one thing to another—money, my relative staying with us, my wife being stressed, church duties, and whether I’m messing up at work. It’s hard to shut it off.
Have you noticed any unexplained weight gain, feeling unusually cold, or dry skin over the past several months?
No, I haven’t really noticed any of those things.
Have you noticed increased thirst or needing to urinate more often than usual lately?
I haven’t noticed being more thirsty or needing to use the bathroom more than usual.
Have you or anyone else noticed that your skin, lips, or nail beds look unusually pale, or do you feel lightheaded or dizzy when standing up?
I haven’t noticed anything like that. I don’t think anyone’s said I look pale either.
Do you ever find yourself unintentionally dozing off or feeling an urge to nap during the day, like while watching TV or sitting in a meeting?
I don’t really doze off during the day, but I feel worn out almost every day. Even after a full night’s sleep, I wake up still dragging when I have to go in for my cashier shift.
